title: Generator input parameters
statement: Given a small-bias Fourier input with bias numerator $a$, denominator $b$, and Fourier bound $B$, its associated generator input has output dimension $n$, numerator $a$, and denominator $bB$. It retains the hypotheses $n>0$, $a>0$, and $2a\\le bB$.
hypotheses_covered: The underlying bias input has output dimension $n>0$.
Twice the bias numerator is at most the bias denominator.
The Fourier bound $B$ is a natural number with $1\\le B$.
